## What this is
A small Python CLI for your NCLEX-PN / Canadian RPN prep. It reads your missed-question tags in `seed/missed.json` (topic, client need, why you missed it) and prints a remediation plan. The plan is 7 days by default, and `-d` lets you set 3–30 days. Other options:
- `-t` limits the plan to one client-need category.
- `--json` prints the plan as JSON instead of text.
- `--studied` logs today as a study day in `studied.json`.

You run it with `python3 remediate.py`, and the code is in `remediation/`. All 76 tests pass. There are no git commits yet; every file is still untracked.

Topics you've missed more than once:

- The section only appears when a topic repeats. Your current `seed/missed.json` has no repeats, so your plan looks exactly as it did before.
